uncataloged.reason: Confirmed against routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:296-336 (new Stage 3 orchestrate block, in range): the wrapper invokes claude -p "/smine-orchestrate $run_branch" which performs the judge/merge/sync on the real main checkout (repo_root), and the only postcondition is a git status --porcelain dirty-tree check after the call returns (lines 324-327) plus a merge-base ancestry check (329-334) — neither path runs git merge --abort or any reset. If the orchestrate agent process is killed mid-merge (routine_run_claude enforces a 3600s timeout and --max-budget-usd cutoff), the checkout is left half-merged and the wrapper only marks orchestrate_status=70 without repairing the tree, so the next nightly run starts from a broken checkout. No golden entry for this file (GV3-009, GV3-046, GV3-098, GV3-099, GV3-114, GV3-196, GV4-205, GV6-251) addresses merge-abort/rollback; this is a distinct root cause from all of them.

Confirmed against cmd/hooks/acdsl-policy-guard.sh:43 (new file, in range) and internal/acdsl/policy.go:139-171. The guard's deny-list at line 43 includes acdsl/registry.local.json among files frozen 'in both modes', but acdsl/README.md's own Modes section lists the frozen self-management surface as only policy.json, policy.schema.json, registry.json, evalgen.json — omitting registry.local.json — and policy.go's overlayViolations() reads acdsl/registry.local.json specifically to validate per-entry local overlay additions against policy.LocalOverrides (the sanctioned local_overrides list), i.e. the authoritative CheckPolicy gate is designed to accept sanctioned edits to that file. The hook's blanket deny therefore blocks a Write/Edit-mediated edit that the policy's own local_overrides mechanism is built to allow, while the same edit remains reachable via Bash + acdsl check. This is a distinct root cause from GV3-199 (Bash commands are entirely uninspected by this hook, a security bypass for policy.json) and from GV3-068/GV3-125 (path-canonicalization and case-sensitivity bypasses) — none of those golden entries address the registry.local.json/local_overrides design conflict.

Confirmed against internal/config/installenv.go:31-38 (new file, in range): installEnvValues only skips a line when strings.Cut fails to find '=' or the key starts with '#' (line 34); for a line shaped KEY=value # comment it proceeds to values[key] = strings.Trim(value, quote), which trims only a wrapping quote pair and leaves the trailing ' # comment' text embedded in the returned value — verified by tracing the code, no inline-comment stripping exists anywhere in the function. This is a distinct root cause from GV3-126, which flags only that the existing comment/no-'=' skip branch (whole-line leading '#') lacks test coverage — GV3-126 does not claim or cover the inline-trailing-comment case at all.
